messages:
Clara (Partnerships): Heads up — we need to migrate ~150 legacy SI onboarding docs from the old Confluence space into the new Partner Portal CMS. Goal: make the core playbooks, certification guides, and lab walkthroughs searchable and taggable by SI role before next week's partner office hours.

Devon (SI Ops): Can you share the migration scope? which folders are priority? :eyes:

Clara (Partnerships): Priority is: 1) Certification curriculum, 2) Bootcamp labs (hardware + cloud marketplace steps), 3) Integration checklists. Low priority: old partner event notes.

Ravi (Docs): Quick note on redirects — we'll need a redirect plan for any external links we break. Also want to normalize headings so CMS renders TOCs cleanly. Could use a CSV mapping: `old_path,new_slug,tags,owner`

Jules (Enablement): I can run two 1-hr office hours for trainers this Thursday/Friday. I'll need sample pages migrated first so we can show the new flow. :white_check_mark:

Clara (Partnerships): Thanks. Devon, can SI Ops do an initial export? then Docs will run a sanitization pass. Estimated ETA for export: EOD today?

Devon (SI Ops): Export is queued. portal-migration-bot: Export job started: export_job_id=ej-88f3

portal-migration-bot: Export completed: 150 files, 0 failures, archive: https://internal-files/redwood/exports/ej-88f3.tar.gz

Ravi (Docs): I'll run a sanitize script to flatten tables and strip old macros. Proposed command: `python tools/sanitize_docs.py --input ej-88f3.tar.gz --out sanitized/ --normalize-headings`

Clara (Partnerships): Important: tagging taxonomy must include: `si_role`, `hardware`, `cloud_marketplace`, `cert_level`, `lab_duration`. Please add these tags when mapping.

Devon (SI Ops): For hardware docs, we should preserve BOMs and SKU references. Any PII or partner-specific customer IDs to remove?

Ravi (Docs): There are a few customer screenshots — will flag those for redaction. I'll add a `redact` column to the CSV.

Jules (Enablement): Also request: add a metadata field `training_video_id` for pages that have recorded walkthroughs so enablement can link classroom content.

Clara (Partnerships): Good idea. Timeline check: export done today, sanitize + tagging by Ravi by tomorrow EOD, import into staging Wed morning, trainers preview Wed afternoon, go-live to partner portal Friday morning (canary to 10% first). Is that doable?

Devon (SI Ops): Works for me. Will create a canary import job and keep logs. Command: `portal-cli import --source sanitized/ --env staging --canary 10`

portal-migration-bot: Import job started: import_job_id=ij-21a4

portal-migration-bot: Import job progress: 45/150 pages imported (staging)

Ravi (Docs): Found 12 pages that require decision on coverage overlap (two playbooks that look like duplicates but with small regional variants). Will create `duplicates.csv` and flag owners.

Clara (Partnerships): Flagging @Jules to decide canonical versions for certification materials. If not resolved by Wed 10:00 PT we'll keep both but mark one as legacy.

Jules (Enablement): I'll review the duplicates list tonight and pick canonicals. Also will prepare a one-pager for trainers about where content moved and the new tag filters.

portal-migration-bot: Import job completed: 150 pages imported to staging, warnings: 3 images missing, 12 duplicates flagged, import_job_id=ij-21a4

Devon (SI Ops): Staging import done. I pushed a short test run for canary 10% — latency and rendering look fine.

Clara (Partnerships): Perfect. Next actions:
- Ravi: finish sanitize + CSV mapping (deadline: Tue EOD)
- Devon: set up staging canary and import logs (Wed AM)
- Jules: trainer one-pager + canonical decisions (Wed 10:00 PT)
- Clara: coordinate partner comms and release note (Thu)

Ravi (Docs): On it. I'll upload `migration_map.csv` once done. Sample mapping snippet below:
```
old_path,new_slug,tags,owner,redact
/confluence/si/certs/level1.md,si/cert-level1,cert_level:1;si_role:admin,Clara (Partnerships),no
/confluence/si/labs/hw-setup.md,si/labs/hw-setup,hardware:gpu;lab_duration:90,Devon (SI Ops),yes
```

Jules (Enablement): FYI I'll run two office hours: Wed 4pm PT (trainers) and Thu 11am PT (partner success). Calendar invites incoming.

Clara (Partnerships): Thanks team — please ping in #partnerships when staging is live so I can prep the partner communication. :pray:

Devon (SI Ops): Will do. Final note: let's add an analytics tag so we can track portal usage for migrated docs (event: `portal_migrate_view`).

Clara (Partnerships): Added to the metadata list. Closing thread for updates — please post progress in this thread so we have a single source of truth.
